title: Excellence of a scheme is detected on an affine open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ be a covering by affine open subschemes such that every ring $\mathcal O_X(U_i)$ is excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring]. Then for every affine open subscheme $V\subseteq X$ the ring $\mathcal O_X(V)$ is excellent. In particular every open subscheme of $X$ is again covered by affine opens with excellent rings.
